purpose: Acceptance contract for API-001: verifiable provider-neutral external review inside the existing Verification Loop.
sourceRequest: Implement recommendations 1-9 so an API reviewer produces verifiable evidence inside the existing ITD architecture.

criteria.criterion: One provider-neutral checker interface includes an OpenAI Responses API adapter and preserves Codex/Gemini alternatives without creating a second completion authority.
criteria.evidence: Focused adapter and routing tests plus Verification Loop integration tests.

criteria.criterion: Routing uses maker provenance and risk tier; same-model/same-provider evidence cannot satisfy high/unknown risk and missing eligible evidence is UNVERIFIED.
criteria.source: Approved recommendations 3-4 and Verification Loop policy.
criteria.evidence: Positive and mutation routing cases bind host-observed provider/model/session metadata.

criteria.criterion: Local review is explicit opt-in advisory/fail-open; CI is provider-neutral and fail-closed on missing exact-candidate evidence, not on one provider outage.
criteria.evidence: Local degradation and CI evidence fixtures distinguish PASSED, FINDINGS, UNAVAILABLE, and UNVERIFIED.

criteria.criterion: Egress requires explicit consent and applies one tested sanitizer, file/byte/token/time/cost limits, complete coverage manifests, no raw diff/output retention, and no persisted API key.
criteria.evidence: Security and budget mutation fixtures fail closed; oversize input is UNVERIFIED rather than silently truncated.

criteria.criterion: Structured verdict, exact candidate SHA/tree/diff manifest, policy/model metadata, observed usage/cost, and immutable prompt/report hashes feed existing Verification Loop evidence.
criteria.evidence: Schema, stale-candidate, tamper, non-live fixture, and receipt-binding mutation cases.

criteria.criterion: A bounded shadow-pilot report measures availability, latency, observed token/cost use, unique actionable findings, false positives, and base-review duplication without claiming live external results when no authorized call occurred.
criteria.evidence: Deterministic pilot fixtures and schema validator; live fields remain explicitly UNOBSERVED until an opt-in run.

criteria.criterion: Documentation and host adapters describe the same model-neutral contracts, honest independence labels, operational bypass boundary, and current tested degradation chain.
criteria.evidence: Host parity, methodology meta-review, quick and full regression pass on the exact candidate.
criteria.verificationCommand: sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_host_adapters.py && sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/meta_review.py && bash tests/run-all.sh --quick && bash tests/run-all.sh

doneRule: API-001 is complete only when every criterion is passed and one current high-risk Verification Loop adjudication re-runs all named commands on the exact staged candidate, consumes a policy-eligible independent checker report, and passes receipt revalidation.
